title: Sidra Noor Fashion
tagline: A storefront with the back office behind it
description: A Vue 3 fashion storefront with the admin dashboard its owner runs it from. The shop side has category pages, product pages, a cart and a checkout; the admin side has eight screens — dashboard, products, orders, customers, messages, staff, profile and a single-product editor. The dashboard opens with no sign-in so you can look straight through it, and every product, order, customer and message in it is invented.
priceNote: setup included · your branding, products and copy
highlights: Eight admin screens: dashboard, products, orders, customers, messages, staff, profile, product editor
Admin opens with no password — there is no database behind it to protect
Edit a product, confirm an order, delete a message — changes stick while you browse
Storefront and admin share one catalogue, so what you change in one shows in the other
Runs with no server at all: the whole API answers inside the page

access.label: Admin dashboard
access.note: No sign-in needed. The Login screen still works if you want to see it, but the dashboard is open — this build has no database and no API, so there is nothing behind it for a password to protect. Anything you change lives in your tab and resets on reload.
